name: binhex-official-metube
description: MeTube is a web GUI for youtube-dl with playlist support. Allows you to download videos from YouTube and dozens of other sites. Features: Download videos from YouTube, Vimeo, and many other sites, Queue downloads and track progress, Playlist support, Dark/light themes, Custom output directories, Audio-only downloads, and much more.

paths.name: /downloads
paths.description: This is the path to store downloaded videos

paths.name: /config
paths.description: This is the path to store MeTube configuration files

ports.name: Web Interface
ports.description: This is the TCP port for the WebUI

variables.name: CUSTOM_DIRS
variables.description: Whether to enable downloading videos into custom directories

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_MODE
variables.description: Controls how downloads are scheduled and executed

variables.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS
variables.description: Maximum number of simultaneous downloads (used with limited mode)

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_DIR
variables.description: Path to where the downloads will be saved

variables.name: DEFAULT_THEME
variables.description: Default theme to use for the UI

variables.name: AUDIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR
variables.description: Path to where audio-only downloads will be saved (defaults to DOWNLOAD_DIR if empty)

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_DIRS_INDEXABLE
variables.description: If true, the download dirs are indexable on the webserver

variables.name: CREATE_CUSTOM_DIRS
variables.description: Whether to support automatically creating directories if they do not exist

variables.name: CUSTOM_DIRS_EXCLUDE_REGEX
variables.description: Regular expression to exclude some custom directories from the drop-down

variables.name: STATE_DIR
variables.description: Path to where the queue persistence files will be saved

variables.name: TEMP_DIR
variables.description: Path where intermediary download files will be saved

variables.name: DELETE_FILE_ON_TRASHCAN
variables.description: If true, downloaded files are deleted when trashed from the UI

variables.name: URL_PREFIX
variables.description: Base path for the web server (for reverse proxy use)

variables.name: PUBLIC_HOST_URL
variables.description: Base URL for download links shown in the UI

variables.name: HTTPS
variables.description: Use HTTPS instead of HTTP (requires CERTFILE and KEYFILE)

variables.name: CERTFILE
variables.description: HTTPS certificate file path

variables.name: KEYFILE
variables.description: HTTPS key file path

variables.name: PUBLIC_HOST_AUDIO_URL
variables.description: Base URL for audio download links

variables.name: OUTPUT_TEMPLATE
variables.description: Template for downloaded video filenames

variables.name: OUTPUT_TEMPLATE_CHAPTER
variables.description: Template for chapter filenames

variables.name: OUTPUT_TEMPLATE_PLAYLIST
variables.description: Template for playlist video filenames

variables.name: DEFAULT_OPTION_PLAYLIST_STRICT_MODE
variables.description: If true, strict playlist mode is enabled by default

variables.name: DEFAULT_OPTION_PLAYLIST_ITEM_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum number of playlist items that can be downloaded (0 = no limit)

variables.name: YTDL_OPTIONS
variables.description: Additional options to pass to yt-dlp in JSON format

variables.name: YTDL_OPTIONS_FILE
variables.description: Path to JSON file for yt-dlp options

variables.name: ROBOTS_TXT
variables.description: Path to robots.txt file mounted in the container

variables.name: LOGLEVEL
variables.description: Log level for the application

variables.name: ENABLE_ACCESSLOG
variables.description: Whether to enable access log

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID under which MeTube will run

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID under which MeTube will run

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Umask value used by MeTube
